svg.title: Three roads from GitHub source to an Amplify-hosted result
svg.desc: A shared source shelf leads to three distinct paths: connected Git Hosting with branch auto build, a deliberately started static ZIP upload, and preview self-managed hosting with owned AWS resources. Each path has its own trigger and stop control. A final note separates stopping releases from removing the served site.

g.text: One source shelf. Three delivery roads.
Connected branch → Amplify build → managed site
Stop: disable that branch's auto build;
check other triggers and active jobs.
Own build + ZIP → manual/CI upload → managed site
check its role and active deployments.
Own deployment → owned distribution and storage
Stop: disable its pipeline or command path;
Stopping new releases does not remove yesterday's site.
